title: ClickPulse — Web Analytics
description: Privacy-first, cookieless web analytics powered by ClickHouse & SigNoz

widgets.title: Unique Visitors (Today)
widgets.query: SELECT uniq(visitor_id) FROM clickpulse.analytics_events WHERE site_id = '{{site_id}}' AND event_type = 'pageview' AND toDate(created_at) = today()

widgets.title: Sessions (Today)
widgets.query: SELECT uniq(session_id) FROM clickpulse.analytics_events WHERE site_id = '{{site_id}}' AND event_type = 'pageview' AND toDate(created_at) = today()

widgets.title: Pageviews (Today)
widgets.query: SELECT count() FROM clickpulse.analytics_events WHERE site_id = '{{site_id}}' AND event_type = 'pageview' AND toDate(created_at) = today()

widgets.title: Bounce Rate % (7 Days)
widgets.query: SELECT round(countIf(hits = 1) * 100.0 / count(), 1) FROM (SELECT session_id, count() AS hits FROM clickpulse.analytics_events WHERE site_id = '{{site_id}}' AND event_type = 'pageview' AND created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY session_id)

widgets.title: Traffic Trends (Pageviews & Visitors)
widgets.query: SELECT toStartOfHour(created_at) AS time, count() AS pageviews, uniq(visitor_id) AS visitors FROM clickpulse.analytics_events WHERE site_id = '{{site_id}}' AND event_type = 'pageview' AND created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 7 DAY GROUP BY time ORDER BY time ASC

widgets.title: Top Pages
widgets.query: SELECT path, count() AS pageviews, uniq(session_id) AS unique_sessions FROM clickpulse.analytics_events WHERE site_id = '{{site_id}}' AND event_type = 'pageview' AND created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY path ORDER BY pageviews DESC LIMIT 15

widgets.title: Top Referrers & Channels
widgets.query: SELECT CASE WHEN referrer = '' OR referrer IS NULL THEN 'Direct / None' WHEN referrer ILIKE '%google%' THEN 'Google Search' WHEN referrer ILIKE '%github%' THEN 'GitHub' WHEN referrer ILIKE '%reddit%' THEN 'Reddit' WHEN referrer ILIKE '%ycombinator%' THEN 'Hacker News' ELSE cutURL(referrer) END AS channel, uniq(session_id) AS sessions FROM clickpulse.analytics_events WHERE site_id = '{{site_id}}' AND event_type = 'pageview' AND created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY channel ORDER BY sessions DESC LIMIT 15

widgets.title: Top Outbound & Affiliate Clicks
widgets.query: SELECT JSONExtractString(event_data, 'title') AS target_title, JSONExtractString(event_data, 'url') AS target_url, count() AS clicks FROM clickpulse.analytics_events WHERE site_id = '{{site_id}}' AND event_type = 'outbound_click' AND created_at >= now() - INTERVAL 30 DAY GROUP BY target_title, target_url ORDER BY clicks DESC LIMIT 15

variables.name: site_id
variables.query: SELECT DISTINCT site_id FROM clickpulse.analytics_events ORDER BY site_id ASC
